rules.statement: Buttons must have a visible focus ring. BUSButton implements :focus-visible via the $bus-ds-focus-ring token — do not override outline to none without replacing it.
When loading=true, BUSButton sets aria-busy. Do not render a separate loading spinner that competes with the built-in one.
Every TextInput, SearchInput, SelectField, ChipsField and MobileNumberInput must have an associated <label> or aria-label. Prefer FormField wrapping which provides the label.
DataTable header cells must declare scope. Use the DataTable column config; do not render a raw <table> without scope on <th>.
ToggleSwitch must expose role=switch and aria-checked reflecting its checked state. Do not build a toggle from a raw checkbox + div.
Checkbox must have an associated label via the label prop or FormField. A bare checkbox with no label fails conformance.
Tabs must support arrow-key navigation between tab triggers and activate on Enter/Space. Use BUSTabStrip which implements this; do not hand-build tabs.
Modal dialogs (BUSPopup / BUSWindow) must trap focus inside and close on Escape. Do not render a modal without these behaviors.
SearchInput with autocomplete must use role=combobox, aria-autocomplete=list, and aria-expanded on the input.
DropdownMenu trigger must have aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; menu items must be keyboard navigable.
Pagination controls must have aria-labels (e.g. 'Go to page 2') and mark the current page with aria-current=page.
StatusPill conveying state should use role=status (or be decorative with aria-hidden) — never a bare styled span for meaningful status.
